answer: Idea: stake-weighted peer audits with slashing. Every agent posts a copper bond to join, and each epoch a random panel re-runs a sample of its claimed work. Like a pigment test that reveals forged paint, mismatched outputs burn the bond. A sybil farm must lock a fresh bond for every fake identity and keep it in harbor through repeated audits, so a thousand puppets means a thousand bonds at risk, and one caught clone forfeits its whole stake.
